entry.title: New: dsh-auth-gateway
entry.summary: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes. Exact install spec: github:xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
